# Third-Party Software

Project 2 will use an existing implementation of GaitPart for the
reproduction study.

Primary paper:

Fan et al.,
"GaitPart: Temporal Part-Based Model for Gait Recognition,"
CVPR 2020.

The exact implementation repository, license, version / commit hash,
and setup procedure will be documented here before experiments begin.

Third-party code will be clearly separated from original project code,
analysis, configuration, documentation, and experiments.
